initiatives.name: Net Zero by 2050 Climate Commitment and Execution
initiatives.summary: Intertek committed to reaching net zero emissions by 2050, with specific 2030 targets of reducing absolute Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions by 50% and Scope 3 emissions by 50% from a 2019 baseline. The company also set a target that 70% of suppliers by spend have science-based targets by 2027.

evidence.title: Net Zero by 2050 with 2030 Emissions Reduction Targets
evidence.summary: Intertek committed to reaching net zero emissions by 2050, with specific 2030 targets of reducing absolute Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions by 50% and Scope 3 emissions by 50% from a 2019 baseline. The company also set a target that 70% of suppliers by spend have science-based targets by 2027.
evidence.quote: A key element of our Sustainability Excellence strategy is our commitment to reaching net zero emissions by 2050, with specific targets for 2030: reducing absolute Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 50%, and Scope 3 by 50% from a 2019 baseline.

evidence.title: Early Achievement of Scope 1, 2 and 3 Emissions Targets
evidence.summary: Intertek reduced market-based emissions by 13.4% year-on-year and met its Scope 1 and 2 reduction target early, achieving a 54.7% reduction against 2019 baseline, as well as meeting its Scope 3 target with a 53.4% reduction against the same baseline.
evidence.quote: Through energy efficiency initiatives, process optimisation and the increased use of low-carbon technologies, we reduced our market-based emissions and met our scope 1 and 2 target early, delivering a 54.7% reduction against our 2019 base year. We also met our scope 3 target, achieving a 53.4% reduction against the same 2019 baseline.

evidence.title: Net Zero by 2050 Climate Transition Plan
evidence.summary: Intertek is committed to reaching net zero emissions by 2050, with an interim target to reduce absolute scope 1, 2 and 3 (business travel and commuting) GHG emissions by 50% before 2030. The plan involves energy efficiency initiatives, renewable energy procurement, and transitioning to lower-carbon transportation.
evidence.quote: We are committed to reaching net zero emissions by 2050, with an interim target to reduce absolute scope 1, scope 2 and scope 3 (business travel and employee commuting) GHG emissions by 50% before 2030.

evidence.title: 13.4% reduction in operational GHG emissions in 2025
evidence.summary: Intertek reduced operational market-based emissions by 13.4% versus 2024 and 54.3% versus its 2019 base year, driven by energy efficiency initiatives, process optimisation, and increased renewable energy use.
evidence.quote: We reduced our operational market-based emissions by 13.4% against 2024 and 54.3% against our base year (2019: 291,519tCO2e). Total operational market-based emissions1 were 133,262tCO2e (2024: 153,807tCO2e).

evidence.title: Four Acquisitions Completed for £157m in 2025
evidence.summary: Intertek completed four acquisitions in 2025 - TESIS (Brazil, building products testing), Envirolab (Australia, environmental testing), Suplilab (Costa Rica, food safety/medical devices testing) and PTL (US, flooring testing) - as part of its disciplined capital allocation strategy to expand its ATIC portfolio in high growth, high margin segments.
evidence.quote: The Group completed four main acquisitions in the year (2024: one): In April 2025, the Group acquired Tecnologia e Qualidade de Sistemas em Engenharia Ltda ('TESIS')... In September 2025, the Group acquired Envirolab... In November 2025, the Group acquired Suplilab... and Professional Testing Laboratory LLC ('PTL')... Total consideration paid was £157.0m, net of cash acquired of £5.9m.

evidence.title: Multiple 2025 acquisitions expanding ATIC footprint
evidence.summary: Intertek made several acquisitions in 2025 including Envirolab (Australia, environmental testing), Suplilab (Costa Rica, expanding Central America footprint), Professional Testing Laboratory (US, products testing), and TESIS (Brazil, Building & Construction), continuing a strategy of ten acquisitions over five years focused on high-growth sectors.
evidence.quote: This year we acquired Envirolab in Australia, an environmental testing provider which established Intertek as a market leader in its field with strong commercial synergies, expanded our Assurance, Testing, Inspection and Certification ('ATIC') footprint in Central America by adding Costa Rica business Suplilab and strengthened our products testing business by buying US-based Professional Testing Laboratory. We also acquired TESIS in Brazil, our third acquisition in the country in the past three years, expanding our Building & Construction business in this important market.

evidence.title: Brazilian fleet transitioned to biofuels
evidence.summary: Intertek replaced fuel for its 145-vehicle corporate fleet in Brazil with renewable biofuels (around 90% ethanol from sugarcane), reducing CO2 emissions by approximately 600 tonnes year-on-year since mid-2024.
evidence.quote: In Brazil, we have replaced the fuel used for our corporate fleet of 145 vehicles to renewable biofuels. Around 90% of fuel consumption now comes from ethanol derived from ethically farmed sugarcane... Having started in mid-2024, the initiative has been implemented across all our sites in Brazil, leading to a reduction of around 600 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent year-on-year.
